title: Cross-Repo Claude Notify: type message into another repo Claude session
desc: Find an active Claude (wkchat) session for a target repo by matching tab title text 'wkchat [REPO]', then type a message into it. Enables wkappbot or harness to wake/notify a Claude session in a different repo -- the universal cross-repo IPC pattern. Caller finds CASCADIA hwnd via wkappbot a11y find proc:wkchat, matches tab text, types message + newline.
steps: IDENTIFY REPO SESSION (one-liner): Add-Type ProcCwd class below, then: Get-Process wkchat
Format-Table. Maps each wkchat PID to its repo CWD (e.g. PID=16944 CWD=D:\GitHub\WkAutoQuant). Use to find target PID for a given repo path.

PROCWD CLASS (copy-paste): Add-Type -TypeDefinition @' using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; using System.Text; public class ProcCwd { [DllImport(kernel32.dll)] static extern IntPtr OpenProcess(uint da, bool ih, int pid); [DllImport(kernel32.dll)] static extern bool ReadProcessMemory(IntPtr ph, IntPtr ba, byte[] buf, int sz, out int rd); [DllImport(kernel32.dll)] static extern bool CloseHandle(IntPtr h); [DllImport(ntdll.dll)] static extern int NtQueryInformationProcess(IntPtr ph, int pic, ref PBI pbi, int sz, out int rl); [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct PBI { public IntPtr r1, PebBase, r2, r3, r4, r5; } public static string GetCwd(int pid) { var h=OpenProcess(0x1410,false,pid); if(h==IntPtr.Zero) return null; try { var pbi=new PBI(); int rl; if(NtQueryInformationProcess(h,0,ref pbi,Marshal.SizeOf(pbi),out rl)!=0) return null; var peb=new byte[0x400]; int rd; if(!ReadProcessMemory(h,pbi.PebBase,peb,peb.Length,out rd)) return null; var ppA=BitConverter.ToInt64(peb,0x20); var pp=new byte[0x500]; if(!ReadProcessMemory(h,new IntPtr(ppA),pp,pp.Length,out rd)) return null; short len=BitConverter.ToInt16(pp,0x38); long ptr=BitConverter.ToInt64(pp,0x40); if(len<=0

ptr==0) return null; var b=new byte[len]; if(!ReadProcessMemory(h,new IntPtr(ptr),b,len,out rd)) return null; return Encoding.Unicode.GetString(b).TrimEnd(new char[]{(char)92,(char)47}); } finally { CloseHandle(h); } } } '@

FIND CASCADIA HWND: wkappbot windows {proc:'wkchat'} output parse -- each result block has 'window {hwnd:0xNNNN CASCADIA}' line + 'element Text wkchat [REPO]' line. Target hwnd = CASCADIA hwnd of the WT window whose active tab is the repo's Claude session. Verified pattern: hwnd:0x606A2 contained WkAutoQuant as active tab (window title reflects active tab task).

FOCUSLESS WRITE (copy-paste): Add-Type -TypeDefinition @' using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; using System.Text; public class WtWrite { [DllImport(user32.dll)] static extern bool EnumChildWindows(IntPtr p, EnumChildProc cb, IntPtr lp); [DllImport(user32.dll)] static extern int GetClassName(IntPtr h, StringBuilder s, int n); [DllImport(user32.dll)] static extern bool PostMessage(IntPtr h, uint msg, IntPtr wp, IntPtr lp); public delegate bool EnumChildProc(IntPtr h, IntPtr lp); public static IntPtr FindInputSite(IntPtr hwnd) { IntPtr r=IntPtr.Zero; EnumChildWindows(hwnd,(h,lp)=>{ var c=new StringBuilder(256); GetClassName(h,c,256); if(c.ToString().Contains(InputSite)){r=h;return false;} return true; },IntPtr.Zero); return r; } public static void Type(IntPtr cascadiaHwnd, string text) { var site=FindInputSite(cascadiaHwnd); if(site==IntPtr.Zero) return; foreach(char c in text){PostMessage(site,0x0102u,(IntPtr)c,IntPtr.Zero);System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(10);} } } '@ ; [WtWrite]::Type([IntPtr]0xCACADIA_HWND, message
